message: The non-streaming request of POST /chat (name generated from operationId "chat") is named "ChatRequest", which is already declared by the schema components.schemas.ChatRequest at #/components/schemas/ChatRequest. fern check fails with "ChatRequest is already declared". Fern splits an operation with an x-fern-streaming stream-condition into a streaming and a non-streaming endpoint, each with its own request. Name the two requests with x-fern-request-name on the operation and stream-request-name in x-fern-streaming.
